- Paratransit Info Desk — ADA paratransit certification; apply by phone, decisions up to 21 days. Eligibility requires ADA certification (not confirmed for this patient).
- Medicaid Ride Line — Medicaid plan members only. Patient has commercial PPO, so NOT eligible.

Utilities options near tract 17031610300:

No appointment facility was provided, so no transit-trip feasibility check was run.
